question: Why does the sage speak again of the seat in this context?
premises: The seat was already spoken of in the supreme worship
Here the sage speaks again for those wishing to enter
He does so according to the order of cognition
inference: The sage restates the teaching of the seat to guide aspirants according to their cognitive progression.
uncertainties: The spacing marker \hspace{3cm} is editorial and not a lexical token.
plain_english: And in the supreme worship the seat was spoken of again; therefore here, for those wishing to enter, the sage speaks according to the order of cognition.
